title: Priority Pointer Reset on Idle
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] last_gnt reset to 0 on idle; Master 3 starved after re-arbitration
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  if (!any_req) last_gnt <= 2'h0;  // Bug: wipes pointer on idle
testbench: task check_fairness(); // Drive M3, then IDLE, then M3 again endtask
expected_root_cause: The priority pointer (last_gnt) resets to zero whenever all requests go idle instead of preserving the last winner, causing the arbiter to always restart from master 0 after any idle period.
description: The priority pointer resets to zero when all requests go idle, breaking fairness — the master that was last served should keep its position so the next grant goes to the following master.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [FAIRNESS] last_gnt reset to 0 on idle; Master 3 starved after re-arbitration
success_log: Priority pointer preserved across idle cycles. Fairness window met for all 4 masters.
